statements.t: We continue to advance enhancements to our CGuard Prime for CAS delivery system, with submission of a PMA supplement to the FDA anticipated before year-end, while progressing our CGUARDIANS III pivotal trial evaluating our proprietary SwitchGuard neuroprotection system for TCAR procedures.
We are also anticipating the introduction of a proprietary micro puncture kit, designed to support vascular access, a critical step in procedural success.
Following management’s formal remarks, there will be a question-and-answer session.
